title: Bug: A2A server GET /tasks/metadata missing return after 501 response — causes ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT crash with GCS task store

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue report clearly describes a systemic code defect in packages/a2a-server/src/http/app.ts where the GET /tasks/metadata endpoint is missing a return statement after sending a 501 HTTP response when taskStoreForExecutor is not an instance of InMemoryTaskStore. This missing return causes execution to fall through and attempt to send a second response, leading to an ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT crash. The issue includes reproduction steps, clear root cause analysis, code snippets, and exact file locations.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: This is a localized bug fix requiring a single-file logic adjustment (adding a missing return statement after sending a 501 response) in packages/a2a-server/src/http/app.ts, along with adding or updating a test in packages/a2a-server/src/http/endpoints.test.ts.

summary.problem: The GET /tasks/metadata endpoint in A2A server causes an ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT server crash when using non-InMemory task stores (e.g. GCSTaskStore).
summary.root_cause: In packages/a2a-server/src/http/app.ts, when taskStoreForExecutor is not an instance of InMemoryTaskStore, the handler sends a 501 response but lacks a return statement. Execution falls through to the try block and attempts to send a second HTTP response (200, 204, or 500).
summary.context: Other early-exit guards in packages/a2a-server/src/http/app.ts, such as in /tasks/:taskId/metadata and handleExecuteCommand, correctly include a return statement after sending error responses.

steps: Locate the GET /tasks/metadata route handler in packages/a2a-server/src/http/app.ts.
Inside the if (!(taskStoreForExecutor instanceof InMemoryTaskStore)) block, add a return; statement immediately after res.status(501).send(...).

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When taskStoreForExecutor is not an instance of InMemoryTaskStore, GET /tasks/metadata returns a 501 response and exits cleanly without throwing ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT or attempting to send a second response.
verification_steps: Add a test case in packages/a2a-server/src/http/endpoints.test.ts to verify GET /tasks/metadata behavior when taskStoreForExecutor is configured with a non-InMemory task store.
Assert that the response status code is 501 and that no secondary response or ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT error is thrown.
